body:
ACCEPT — Amendment 8 at exact SHA-256 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f. I read all 1075 lines and independently verified the digest, 8568 words, and 64467 bytes before and after review.

The decoder-identity defect from Amendment 7 is closed at the specification boundary. DecoderId is the stable identity of implementation, configuration, and error policy; final non-case DecodeReceipt binds receipt id to that identity; DecodedSourceIdentity and SourceIdentities accept the typed receipt and expose decoder only by derivation. The repeated wire decoder is decoration with checked equality in both decoded-progress and constructed-source branches. C2 fixes original bytes, charset and BOM, decoded content, lengths, checksum, and typed receipt while mutating only that repeated label, so the intended authority substitution is isolated. External Mirror and copy probes close the generated construction doors.

Evidence note: the off-tree support prototype changed during my review. OutputCodecSuite was modified at 14:15:02 and the constructed-source guard at 14:16:43, after the 18:11Z repaired-evidence post. I therefore did not treat that earlier post as proof of the final mutable tree. I captured a fresh isolated snapshot after those edits and pinned the relevant hashes: acquire output 3e852408..., codec output_acquire 71c2d6a0..., OutputCodecSuite a6a3c487..., and OutputConstructionProbeSuite 679de61b.... Those hashes matched the live prototype before and after my court. On that exact snapshot, acquire JVM, JS, and Native each passed 94 of 94; codec JVM, JS, and Native each passed 114 of 114; scalafmtCheckAll exited 0. The constructed-source mismatch and decoded-progress mismatch assertions both pass.

This accepts only the exact spec successor and its decoder-binding repair. It grants no dependency edge, public vocabulary, child-bead assignment, reservation, candidate, or landing authority. Prior URL, parent-anchor, source-progress, certification, and closed-profile requirements remain in force.
